020package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.checks.javadoc;
021
022import java.util.HashSet;
023import java.util.Set;
024
025import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.FileStatefulCheck;
026import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.DetailAST;
027import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.DetailNode;
028import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.FullIdent;
029import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.JavadocCommentsTokenTypes;
030import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.TokenTypes;
031import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.JavadocUtil;
032
033/**
034 * <div>
035 * Checks that {@code Error} types are not documented in {@code @throws} or
036 * {@code @exception} Javadoc tags.
037 * </div>
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Per the documentation comments style guide, errors generally should not be
041 * documented because they are unpredictable. This check reports documented
042 * throwable names whose simple name ends with {@code Error}, unless the same
043 * Error type is explicitly thrown with {@code throw new} in the documented
044 * method or constructor.
045 * </p>
046 *
047 * @since 14.1.0
048 */
049@FileStatefulCheck
050public class JavadocNoErrorInThrowsTagCheck extends AbstractJavadocCheck {
051
052    /**
053     * A key is pointing to the warning message text in "messages.properties"
054     * file.
055     */
056    public static final String MSG_KEY = "javadoc.no.error.in.throws.tag";
057
058    /** Type names explicitly thrown in the current documented construct. */
059    private final Set<String> thrownTypeNames = new HashSet<>();
060
061    /**
062     * Creates a new {@code JavadocNoErrorInThrowsTagCheck} instance.
063     */
064    public JavadocNoErrorInThrowsTagCheck() {
065        // no code by default
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public int[] getDefaultTokens() {
070        return getRequiredTokens();
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public final int[] getRequiredTokens() {
075        return new int[] {
076            TokenTypes.METHOD_DEF,
077            TokenTypes.CTOR_DEF,
078            TokenTypes.COMPACT_CTOR_DEF,
079        };
080    }
081
082    @Override
083    public int[] getDefaultJavadocTokens() {
084        return getRequiredJavadocTokens();
085    }
086
087    @Override
088    public int[] getRequiredJavadocTokens() {
089        return new int[] {
090            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.THROWS_BLOCK_TAG,
091            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.EXCEPTION_BLOCK_TAG,
092        };
093    }
094
095    @Override
096    public void visitToken(DetailAST ast) {
097        final DetailAST blockCommentNode = JavadocUtil.getAttachedJavadocComment(ast);
098        if (blockCommentNode != null) {
099            collectThrownErrorTypes(ast);
100            try {
101                super.visitToken(blockCommentNode);
102            }
103            finally {
104                thrownTypeNames.clear();
105            }
106        }
107    }
108
109    @Override
110    public void visitJavadocToken(DetailNode ast) {
111        final DetailNode identifier = JavadocUtil.findFirstToken(
112                ast, JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.IDENTIFIER);
113
114        if (identifier != null
115                && isErrorType(identifier.getText())
116                && !isExplicitlyThrown(identifier.getText())) {
117            final String tagName = getTagName(ast);
118            log(ast, MSG_KEY, identifier.getText(), tagName);
119        }
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * Collects type names explicitly thrown by {@code throw new} in a construct.
124     *
125     * @param ast documented construct
126     */
127    private void collectThrownErrorTypes(DetailAST ast) {
128        DetailAST current = ast;
129        while (current != null) {
130            if (current.getType() == TokenTypes.LITERAL_THROW
131                    && !isInIgnoreBlock(ast, current)) {
132                collectThrownErrorType(current);
133            }
134
135            if (current.hasChildren()) {
136                current = current.getFirstChild();
137            }
138            else {
139                while (!current.equals(ast) && current.getNextSibling() == null) {
140                    current = current.getParent();
141                }
142                if (current.equals(ast)) {
143                    current = null;
144                }
145                else {
146                    current = current.getNextSibling();
147                }
148            }
149        }
150    }
151
152    /**
153     * Collects type name from a {@code throw new} statement.
154     *
155     * @param throwAst throw statement
156     */
157    private void collectThrownErrorType(DetailAST throwAst) {
158        final DetailAST expressionAst = throwAst.getFirstChild();
159        final DetailAST firstExpressionAst = expressionAst.getFirstChild();
160        if (firstExpressionAst.getType() == TokenTypes.LITERAL_NEW) {
161            final String typeName = FullIdent.createFullIdentBelow(firstExpressionAst)
162                    .getText();
163            thrownTypeNames.add(getSimpleName(typeName));
164        }
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * Checks if a 'throw' usage is contained within a block that should be ignored.
169     * Such blocks consist of try (with catch) blocks, local classes, anonymous classes,
170     * and lambda expressions. Note that a try block without catch is not considered.
171     *
172     * @param constructAst DetailAST node representing the documented construct
173     * @param throwAst DetailAST node representing the 'throw' literal
174     * @return true if throwAst is inside a block that should be ignored
175     */
176    private static boolean isInIgnoreBlock(DetailAST constructAst, DetailAST throwAst) {
177        DetailAST ancestor = throwAst;
178        while (!ancestor.equals(constructAst)) {
179            if (ancestor.getType() == TokenTypes.LAMBDA
180                    || ancestor.getType() == TokenTypes.OBJBLOCK
181                    || ancestor.findFirstToken(TokenTypes.LITERAL_CATCH) != null) {
182                break;
183            }
184            if (ancestor.getType() == TokenTypes.LITERAL_CATCH
185                    || ancestor.getType() == TokenTypes.LITERAL_FINALLY) {
186                ancestor = ancestor.getParent();
187            }
188            ancestor = ancestor.getParent();
189        }
190        return !ancestor.equals(constructAst);
191    }
192
193    /**
194     * Checks whether class name is an Error type name.
195     *
196     * @param className class name
197     * @return true if class name is an Error type name
198     */
199    private static boolean isErrorType(String className) {
200        return className.endsWith("Error");
201    }
202
203    /**
204     * Checks whether Error type is explicitly thrown in current documented construct.
205     *
206     * @param className class name
207     * @return true if Error type is explicitly thrown in current documented construct
208     */
209    private boolean isExplicitlyThrown(String className) {
210        return thrownTypeNames.contains(getSimpleName(className));
211    }
212
213    /**
214     * Gets simple class name.
215     *
216     * @param className class name
217     * @return simple class name
218     */
219    private static String getSimpleName(String className) {
220        return className.substring(className.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
221    }
222
223    /**
224     * Gets the Javadoc tag name from a throws or exception block tag.
225     *
226     * @param ast throws or exception block tag
227     * @return tag name with leading at sign
228     */
229    private static String getTagName(DetailNode ast) {
230        return "@" + JavadocUtil.findFirstToken(ast,
231                JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TAG_NAME).getText();
232    }
233
234}
